targets.rawSql: SELECT name, hardware_type, is_active, last_seen_at FROM probes_probe ORDER BY last_seen_at DESC NULLS LAST;
SELECT h.time AS "time", p.name AS metric, h.cpu_temp_c AS value FROM telemetry_probehealth h JOIN probes_probe p ON p.id = h.probe_id WHERE $__timeFilter(h.time) ORDER BY 1;

SELECT r.time AS "time", p.name AS metric, r.value AS value FROM telemetry_sensorreading r JOIN probes_probe p ON p.id = r.probe_id WHERE r.sensor_type = 'temperature_c' AND $__timeFilter(r.time) ORDER BY 1;

SELECT r.time AS "time", p.name AS metric, r.value AS value FROM telemetry_sensorreading r JOIN probes_probe p ON p.id = r.probe_id WHERE r.sensor_type = 'humidity_pct' AND $__timeFilter(r.time) ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Gas Resistance (uncalibrated -- higher is generally cleaner air)

targets.rawSql: SELECT r.time AS "time", p.name AS metric, r.value AS value FROM telemetry_sensorreading r JOIN probes_probe p ON p.id = r.probe_id WHERE r.sensor_type = 'gas_resistance_ohm' AND $__timeFilter(r.time) ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Air Quality Index (heuristic)
panels.description: NOT an official/certified AQI -- a real calibrated IAQ requires Bosch's proprietary BSEC library, out of scope here (see probe/weathernet_probe/sensors/bme680.py). This is a relative indicator only: 75% weight on the latest gas resistance vs. its 7-day rolling maximum (higher resistance = cleaner air), 25% weight on humidity comfort (best near 40%). 100 = best observed conditions recently, not an absolute standard.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest_gas AS (
  SELECT r.value AS gas_resistance
  FROM telemetry_sensorreading r
  WHERE r.sensor_type = 'gas_resistance_ohm'
  ORDER BY r.time DESC LIMIT 1
),
baseline_gas AS (
  SELECT max(r.value) AS gas_baseline
  FROM telemetry_sensorreading r
  WHERE r.sensor_type = 'gas_resistance_ohm' AND r.time > now() - interval '7 days'
),
latest_hum AS (
  SELECT r.value AS humidity
  FROM telemetry_sensorreading r
  WHERE r.sensor_type = 'humidity_pct'
  ORDER BY r.time DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT round(
  0.75 * least(100, 100.0 * latest_gas.gas_resistance / nullif(baseline_gas.gas_baseline, 0))
  + 0.25 * (100 - least(100, abs(latest_hum.humidity - 40) * 2.5))
) AS "Air Quality Index"
FROM latest_gas, baseline_gas, latest_hum;
